# Draft:Edward T. Broughton

Edward Thomas Broughton and Edward Thomas Broughton Jr. should link here
Edward T. Broughton (1834-1874) was a lawyer and Confederate Army officer who served several terms in the Texas Senate. Independent.
He and his wife lived in Kaufman, Texas before the Civil War and he was elected district attorney there in 1861. He was taien orisoner by the Union Army twice.  He was elected in the 1869 Texas Senate election.
A historical marker commemorates Capt. Edward Thomas Broughton and the Johnson Guards.
Dempsey W. Broughton (1824–1890) was his brother.
